turns.speaker: interviewer
turns.text: Tell me about a specific disagreement during a project. Explain your role, how and why you responded, the outcome, and what you learned.

turns.speaker: candidate
turns.text: During our hackathon, my teammate and I disagreed about an API response change. I compared the request and response payloads with my teammate instead of arguing about implementation preferences because the demo deadline was close. My teammate wanted to preserve the old format. We fixed the issue and the demo went well. I learned that communication is important.

turns.speaker: interviewer
turns.text: What was your responsibility, and what concern was your teammate raising?

turns.speaker: candidate
turns.text: I owned the API adapter, and my teammate owned the client. Their concern was that my response format would break existing clients. I suggested comparing payloads instead of arguing about implementation preferences. We opened the old client together and inspected which fields it needed.

turns.speaker: interviewer
turns.text: What evidence showed what happened afterward, and what would you change next time?

turns.speaker: candidate
turns.text: The adapter passed the three existing client test cases. I did not compare an alternative approach, and I cannot separate our adapter change from the other fixes made before the demo. I would add a shared example payload before implementing the next API change.
